assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds dynamic client-side throttling for GCS object storage, to avoid hitting object storage rate limits.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The changelog line names no config key, flag or default. It does not say whether the throttling is on by default or must be turned on. It only says the feature is limited to GCS, and no predicate here can express 'uses GCS as object storage'.; consequence: The evidence is a one-line feature entry. It does not say how behaviour changes for existing GCS users or whether any operator action is needed.
